name: Leaflet 5 (Ships) Annex D
source: DE&S S&EP Leaflet 5, Issue 3, October 2020 -- Annex D, Ships Common Risk Classification Matrix

likelihoodClasses.label: Frequent
likelihoodClasses.description: Likely to occur repeatedly on the ship during its life

likelihoodClasses.label: Probable
likelihoodClasses.description: Likely to occur from time to time

likelihoodClasses.label: Occasional
likelihoodClasses.description: May occur once during the ship's life

likelihoodClasses.label: Remote
likelihoodClasses.description: Unlikely to occur during the ship's life

riskClasses.label: A - Intolerable
riskClasses.description: Risk shall be reduced regardless of cost unless the cost is grossly disproportionate to the benefit gained.

riskClasses.label: B - Undesirable
riskClasses.description: Risk shall be reduced as far as reasonably practicable (ALARP).
riskClasses.reviewPeriod: Reduce as soon as reasonably practicable

riskClasses.label: C - Tolerable
riskClasses.description: Risk is tolerable provided it has been reduced ALARP and is periodically reviewed.

riskClasses.label: D - Broadly Acceptable
riskClasses.description: Risk is broadly acceptable; no further action required beyond routine monitoring.
